{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the number of unique patients and duplicates
n_total_rows = len(df)
n_unique_patients = len(df_dedup)
n_duplicates = n_total_rows - n_unique_patients

# Confirm the unit conversion factor from the data dictionary
unit_conversion_factor = 10  # 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL

# Now, handle the assay_batch unit error: batch B values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ng_ml'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final_ng_ml = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'n_total_rows = {n_total_rows}')
print(f'n_unique_patients = {n_unique_patients}')
print(f'n_duplicates = {n_duplicates}')
print(f'unit_conversion_factor = {unit_conversion_factor}')
print(f'mean_biomarker_final_ng_ml = {mean_biomarker_final_ng_ml}')"}
